pageDescription: Bring Agent traffic into Centag in three steps: start MITM, self-check, then connect with wrap.

guide.rulesMeta: Defaults included ({domains} domains / {patterns} paths); they decide proxy scope — usually no change
guide.nextStartMitmDesc: Turn on the switch below. The egress key is bound automatically in most cases.
guide.nextEgressDesc: Expand step 1 “More options” to bind manually, or toggle MITM once.
guide.nextVerifyDesc: Confirm MITM, PAC, and egress key before installing the client.
guide.nextClient: Server is ready — connect a client
guide.nextClientDesc: Copy the wrap command to start your Agent. First-time users: expand Install & Token.
guide.step1Summary: Enable MITM. Turn on Allow LAN only when colleagues need access. Permissions and manual bind are under More options.

wizard.lead: 3 steps: Enable MITM (Egress Key auto-ready) → Self-check → Install client and run centag wrap run. Do not put proxy in global shell.
wizard.dockerWarning: Docker: Host must map port 8081, container MITM listens on 0.0.0.0. Use ./start.sh docker run personal to restart.
wizard.step1Description: MITM and Centag are integrated: when enabled, the server auto-creates/binds the internal Egress Key and injects it when forwarding to :{port}. Wrap only sets proxy env vars—no need to configure this key.
wizard.step2Description: Confirm local egress works before installing the client.
wizard.step3Description: Install the personal CLI with centag wrap, pick an Agent client, then copy the launch command. This is proxy wrap access—not the same as writing local files on Agent Setup.
wizard.selectAgentHint: Wrap injects CA and HTTPS_PROXY automatically; commands below follow the selected client.
wizard.checkEgressNotReady: Egress Key not ready (should auto-bind after MITM enabled)
wizard.checkCert: Certificate error → download & trust CA from Advanced tab
wizard.selfCheckHint: Page self-checks MITM / PAC / Egress Key / CA; for end-to-end, use diagnostic command or wrap run.
wizard.subStep1Hint: After install run . "$HOME/.centag/env", confirm centag wrap --help works. Dev machines can also use ./start.sh build personal.
wizard.subStep2: ② For LAN: set employee Token first (skip on local machine)
wizard.subStep2Hint: LAN is enabled: without Token set, wrap will error; bare MITM connection returns 407.
wizard.subStep3: ③ Use wrap to start Agent (auto CA + HTTPS_PROXY; LAN auto-includes proxy auth)
wizard.runWithEnv: Recommended: start via env vars (shorter commands)
wizard.runWithEnvHint: Export in this terminal only (do not put in ~/.zshrc), then use the short run command. Create a Token in Profile → API Keys.
wizard.runWithFlagsHint: Pass --server / --token on the same line when you skip env vars.
wizard.envScriptComment: Current terminal only; do not write into shell rc files
wizard.optionalPac: Optional: System PAC / Manual Environment Variables
wizard.pacHint: Most CLIs don't read system PAC. PAC: {url}
wizard.permissionHint: Permissions: Local-only mode doesn't enforce proxy auth. With LAN enabled, non-local clients must use Proxy-Authorization (set by centag wrap writing CENTAG_WRAP_TOKEN into HTTPS_PROXY; third-party Agents don't need Centag Key). Egress Key is still auto-injected by server, separate from employee Token.
wizard.lanHint: Enable only for trusted intranets; open firewall for {apiPort} / {listenPort}. Employees need: export CENTAG_WRAP_TOKEN=llmproxy_… (Web → API Keys), then use wrap run.
wizard.runningAlertDesc: Step 1 is still below. Turn off the MITM Service switch, or click Stop MITM.

egress.notReadyTitle: Egress Key not ready? Manual bind (usually unnecessary)
egress.stillNotReady: Egress Key still not ready, expand below to bind manually
egress.notConfigured: Egress Key not configured (MITM cannot inject auth)

cards.pacWhitelistHint: Only whitelisted domains go through proxy. Default list covers LLM service domains in Provider directory; add/remove as needed.
cards.pathPatternsHint: Domains must be whitelisted. Matched paths are rewritten to Centag's /v1/*; common LLM paths on whitelisted domains are also forwarded.
cards.caCertHint: HTTPS requires trusting this CA, otherwise certificate errors occur

options.pacMode: PAC Mode (proxy specified domains only, recommended)

dialog.addDomainHint: Enter domain only, without protocol or path

wizardCheck.mitmStopped: MITM not started (enable in step 1 first)
wizardCheck.dockerHint: Docker deployment: confirm host has mapped 8081 (./start.sh docker run personal)
wizardCheck.hasFailed: Self-check failed, address the issues below

message.defaultsUpdated: Default list is already up to date
message.fillLanIP: Please select or enter your LAN IP, then click Save
message.lanIPRequired: LAN IP is required when LAN access is enabled
message.autoDetectFailed: Auto-detection failed, please enter LAN IP manually (e.g. 192.168.x.x)
message.multipleInterfaces: Filled {ip}, click candidates below if multiple NICs
message.lanConfirmMessage: Enabling LAN makes MITM reachable on 0.0.0.0 and enforces proxy auth for non-local clients. Employees must set CENTAG_WRAP_TOKEN and use centag wrap run. Continue?
message.globalModeWarning: Global mode proxies all HTTP/HTTPS traffic, which may affect other apps. Switch?
